item.title: Version 0.4.0
item.description:
Added

  • Multi-org workspace switcher. If your Apple Ads account has multiple organizations, the sidebar now shows the active one and lets you switch between them. Each org keeps its own campaigns, history, and refresh state — switching orgs no longer mixes data across them.
  • Ask the assistant to switch workspaces. The chat has new list_orgs and switch_org tools, so you can say “list my orgs” or “switch to my testing org” and follow-up requests run against the new one.
  • Clickable links in chat answers. Campaign, ad group, and app names in chat replies are now in-app links — clicking one jumps to that page in ADSwift instead of popping a new window.

Changed

  • Update checks run every 4 hours during the beta instead of every 24 hours, so fixes land sooner.
  • Multi-step chat requests are batched. Asking for “the report for last week and bump campaign X to $30” now executes both actions in a single round trip in the order you asked.

Fixed

  • All Campaigns view: the RC Revenue column now totals across every app instead of being silently scoped to whichever app you last opened from the toolbar.
  • Chat-emitted links no longer pop a fresh ADSwift window — they reuse the existing main window.
  • Bold text wrapped around chat links no longer leaks literal ** asterisks.
  • Spend sparklines stretch to fill their column width instead of sitting at a fixed narrow size.
